title: Realize the selected caller's monomials and J routes as fixed f-independent record lists (no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Before:** PR #5442 splits `native_all_columns` for the selected #5413 caller into an algebraic half, which it closes, and a physical half: executing `g^{⊗f}` and the port adapters on a fixed number of tapes, for all `f` columns at once with one fixed primitive list, without disturbing spectators, at the retained tariff. `SPECIALIZATION.md` §2–§3 (the P1 specialization of #4610) states that realization in writing (≤171 records per nine-axis monomial, each a compact-control selected-bit addition or a phase record) but executes none of it on the actual inventory.

**After:** `research/selected-monomial-tape-lift` executes the record-level part of the physical half. Status: one written lemma (record realization, uniform in `f`) with exhaustive and sampled execution; no new κ, no selected-record change.
- Every one of the **896 compiled port wrappers** of `NORMALIZERS.json` is a fixed list of at most 107 records (`XROW`/`NOT` movement records = compact-control selected-bit additions/translations; `S`/`CZ`/global-`i` phase records). The list does not depend on `f` and realizes the lift `m^{⊗f}` exactly, spectators untouched.
- The body's **own 1,088 monomial words** (283 distinct: 800 whole-job helper normalizers, 240 Z-map block maps, 32 C8 routes and aliases, and the provider's 8 mode `output_N` words that #5442's mode-output certificate binds) are fixed lists of at most 76 records each, read off the exact engine as group elements and executed at `f = 1` exhaustively and `f = 2, 3, 4` sampled. (Added in 377c2c780; the first version covered only the port wrappers and wrongly said the helper aliases were among them.)
- The **central translation** `X0` is one record; `C0` and `D` are positive-rank Gaussians, i.e. paid children of the recursion (`FINITE-PRECOMPILATION.md` §1), not adapters.
- The literal `pre_word`/`post_word` of all **119 targets** of `WHOLECALLER-PLAN-v1` (**16,748 `SWAP_BITS`** events on 145 axes) are three `XROW` records each and realize the declared permutations; the 16 central `X` corrections are one record each.
- The tariff per movement record is the compact-control Proposition (`notes/compact-control-movement.tex`): `O(V((f log p)^τ+1))` on fixed tapes for `f ≤ p`, `A = O(p)`. That domain is the actual layer's own domain (`f ≤ e ≤ b_in^ε`, `p = 6 b_in`, SPECIALIZATION §3), so `f ≤ p` is not a gap.

Remaining obligations: the Proposition's own proof (four-update rotation scheme, overflow repair, chunk swaps) is not executed; the control-field reservations of `compact-control-layout.tex` for the 145-axis layout are taken as written; no numerical tariff.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`; package commit `36167d06b`. Inputs pinned in SOURCES.json: `SPECIALIZATION.md`, the two compact-control notes, `NORMALIZERS.json` and `WHOLECALLER-PLAN-v1.json` (the #5413 capsule), `clifford_exact.py`, `prune_native.py`. Task card `formal-interface-lemma`, scope **refined** (TASK.json). Nearest work: #5442 (algebraic half; its open question is exactly this interface), #4610/P1 SPECIALIZATION (written realization), #5443 (our record counts of the compiler and the completion/splitting pass; together they give the record-level bill of the compiled template, the price per record being the Proposition's tariff).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-monomial-tape-lift
```

PASS locally on CPython 3.12 (Windows), standard library only (about 100 s; controls under a second); `check_research_commit.py` passes. Evidence: all 896 wrappers at `f = 1` on all 512 addresses with random spectators; 8 wrappers against the exact Clifford engine's basis action; 2 wrappers at `f = 2` on all 262,144 addresses; all 896 at `f = 2, 3, 4` on 48 random addresses each; every wrapper within the §2 bound (maximum 107 records: 69 movement, 38 phase); `X0`; all 238 literal route words at `f = 2` on 145 axes. Controls (`test_verify.py`): an unlifted global phase fails at `f = 2` (the §3 mutation); a dropped row addition, a removed swap, a single-column phase record and an asymmetric `Q` are rejected; spectators untouched; transposition chains. Finite executions corroborate the lemma; the all-`f` statement is the written proof in PROOF.md. Not run: the forward body's wrappers, the Proposition's internal scheme, Lean.

## Credit

Cao Yifan / intqwq (#4610 and the P1 specialization), Cinna Davis (compact-control notes, controller/helper lineage), zxv (#4359 free-word substitution, #5428), Chris R / Clear1nsight (#5413), Dillon (#5402), Ali Romman (#5383/#5398/#5376), Dugongue and icekylinx (Clifford engine lineage), and the parallel #5442 census. Apache-2.0. Prepared by Mark (Matarener) with substantial Claude Code assistance; no independent human or formal-kernel review.

## Open next questions

1. Execute the Proposition: a bit-level simulator of the four-update rotation scheme with dirty compact fields `u, t, b`, chunk swaps and overflow repair at small `f, K, G`.
2. Map the plan's active axes and stage planes onto the `q_0, q_F, q_B` chunk reservations of `compact-control-layout.tex`.
3. Replay the forward body's wrappers (review only).
